notes: 5 code banks + 1 data + soft-stack (vi footprint). Real port ballast (cmp/df/cp/cal, plain-compiled + inert) fills seg1-4; seg0 carries crt0_lib, the fcc runtime and libc's hand-written code, and no ballast; libc's functions are in libc banks of their own. Every cross-bank call/fn-ptr construct has its callee in a SEPARATE extern-linkage TU pinned to a different segment than its caller (see 'callees'; the gen_sweep_link lint enforces it). Data-global-deref constructs are cross-bank BY CONSTRUCTION (data seg is a separate bank), so their placement is free. c20/errno deferred pending the libc errno seam (task #28). c36-c39 = P3-2 pointer-model edges (ptr compare, dual live chains, FPR pressure/ternary join, ptr return via cross-bank fn-ptr). c43 = the far-pointer TRUTH TEST (issue #6): if(p)/!p/ternary/&&/|| must weigh the bank byte so a bank:0000 pointer is not read as NULL, while a real NULL stays NULL -- placement is free, the pointer's bank comes from DBR rather than the code bank.
seg0 holds the driver and mbio; groups 1-4 are fgx_static segments 2-5 (segment 1 is the data).
